records.rationale: Retain station callbacks/notifications on wireless_dev, WDEV reply identifiers and optional IFINDEX, allowing netdev-less NAN management stations while preserving ordinary netdev wrappers, locking, allocation cleanup and station validation. Retain caller/signature adjustments in all affected in-tree drivers for common module source consistency, without enabling new hardware platforms or preserving binary KMI. Subsequent NAN creation/change/delete support supersedes intermediate guards. Adapt GET_STATION to admit NAN just as existing dump does; all other non-netdev types remain rejected. Existing station-read permissions remain, administrative mutations retain admin checks. Actual command-body host tests cover allocation/callback/serialization failures, not real netlink or runtime. Native serializer and cleanup differ only by wdev arguments/identifiers, with function deltas recorded.
evidence: SECURITY.md: NAN station and key callback conversions

records.rationale: Retain add/get/delete/default-management/default-beacon key callbacks on wireless_dev, affected driver/caller/trace conversions and netlink WDEV identifiers. Ordinary default data keys remain netdev-only. Preserve admin permissions, secret skb clearing for SET/NEW, link/cipher/length/index validation and key lifetime/reinstall protection. Final hwsim advertises SECURE_NAN only when NAN is enabled, so the original commit comment that nobody advertises it is no longer true. Correct the inherited mac80211 NAN WARN/absent management-key flag using local upstream 014eec318fc0; preserve PD rejection when resolving its adjacent context conflict. RX_MGMT is set only for a present MFP peer, as for AP peers. No new cipher or security-feature advertisement and no removal of an LTS fix. Native command-body differences are argument/identifier adaptation plus separately reviewed NAN key-validation context. Host flag-dispatch tests verify unchanged non-NAN behavior with/without mesh; no cryptographic runtime claim.
evidence: SECURITY.md: NAN station and key callback conversions

source_contract_limitations: GET_STATION already permits unprivileged station reads, as does station dumping; no new key-reading permissions. Netlink pre-dispatch resolves wiphy/wdev in caller network namespace and locks as before.
Key API conversion does not itself implement NAN discovery/authentication/crypto. Physical drivers still require their supported netdev interfaces; their signatures are converted for API coherence.
Pinned supplicant older draft NAN protocol mismatch is separately recorded in nan-supplicant-uapi.json. No assertion of complete wire/runtime compatibility.
Local upstream source 9e947d96915a and its ancestor 014eec318fc0 were consulted; no message link in that commit was opened.
